plugins.name: zcode-switchman
plugins.description: Fixed six-lane sub-agent fleet for ZCode: shells self-provision at session start (bodies auto-sync; the user-owned `model:`/`thoughtLevel:` lines pass through every sync verbatim — never rewritten, dropped, or injected; only creation writes the built-in `model: inherit`), a failure breaker, a shell context guard (absolute-k tiers, once-per-tier advisories, HANDOFF relay), a per-project language preference (first-run ask → [LANG] iron rule), and read-only bash for ro shells (git diff/log/show-class inspection behind a hook-enforced view/search allowlist; writes denied). Ships three companion skills: git-commit-message, requirement-docs, db-query (read-only MySQL/Redis), a token-economy routing rule (per-turn [ROUTE] iron rule: state self-vs-dispatch in one sentence and weigh context length; banner [Rule] line; opt out via settings), a code-comment format iron rule (per-turn [COMMENT] line + banner [Comment] line: every code comment follows [yyyy-mm-dd]-[why]-[impact]; opt out via settings), and a hint-only DB advisory (a [DB] line when the user prompt or a Bash command looks database-related: prefer the db-query skill; never blocks; opt out via settings)., a compact-tier read budget (oversized Reads capped in-flight via PreToolUse updatedInput, the one entry-side lever the platform grants; readBudgetLines setting), a Stop-driven auto-handover (at the compact tier the first stop is blocked once to write the handover doc + pointer; a per-turn UserPromptSubmit pickup consumes it after an in-session /compact), and a strictly silent dispatch ledger (one JSONL line per Agent/Task result: lane, outcome, usage — zero extra model traffic), an opt-in matrix-driven shell rebinding (settings "matrix": "on" + a user-owned .switchman/shells.json: lane pins written into the shell frontmatter at session start and every user turn, so a matrix edit lands on the next message — turn-granular model rotation via the host per-turn agent refresh), and an opt-in image relay (settings "imageRelay": "on": a raster-image Read on a text-only main model is denied with the steer to dispatch switchman-vision via DELEGATION_V1 with the path)

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 固定六档子代理编队：会话启动自动装配六壳（正文自动同步；`model:`/`thoughtLevel:` 两行为用户私产，每次同步原样透传——绝不改写、丢弃或凭空注入，仅创建时写入内置 `model: inherit`）；失败熔断、壳上下文守卫（绝对 k 三档、每档一次、HANDOFF 接力）、项目级语言偏好（首启三问 → [LANG] 铁律），以及 ro 壳的只读 Bash（hook 强制的查看/搜索白名单放行 git diff/log/show 类操作，写入一律拒绝）。随插件附带三个技能：git-commit-message、requirement-docs、db-query（只读 MySQL/Redis 核验）、token 账派发纪律（每轮 [ROUTE] 铁律：动手前一句话权衡自己做还是派、并考虑上下文长度；横幅 [Rule] 行，设置可关）、代码注释格式铁律（每轮 [COMMENT] 行 + 横幅 [Comment] 行：所有代码注释按 [yyyy-mm-dd]-[why]-[impact] 书写；设置可关），以及只提示不拦截的 DB 引导（提示词或 Bash 命令像查库时注入 [DB] 行：优先用 db-query 技能；绝不拦截；设置可关）。，compact 档读预算（超限 Read 由 PreToolUse updatedInput 飞行中封顶——平台给的唯一入口侧杠杆；readBudgetLines 设置项）、Stop 驱动的自动交接（compact 档首次收尾被阻断一次，写好交接文档 + 指针；会话内 /compact 后由逐轮 UserPromptSubmit 拾取注入），以及严格静默的派发台账（每条 Agent/Task 结果一行 JSONL：档位、结果、用量——零额外模型流量），可选的矩阵驱动壳重绑（settings "matrix": "on" + 用户私有 .switchman/shells.json：会话启动与每轮把档位钉进壳 frontmatter，改矩阵下一条消息即生效——搭宿主每轮 agent 刷新实现轮粒度换模型），以及可选的图像中继（settings "imageRelay": "on"：文本-only 主模型的图片 Read 被拒绝并附改派——经 DELEGATION_V1 把路径交给 switchman-vision）
